[GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Families Leaves > Statutory Partner/Paternity Leave]
Time to bond with your new child and support your partner.

Leave Entitlement

* 5 days paid Birth Leave (100% salary), to be used within 4 weeks of birth
* 5 weeks paid Additional Birth Leave within 6 months (at 70% of maximum day wage)
* Review [company policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave) as when more beneficial they supersede the statutory leave benefits

How to Access

1. Email [leaves@gitlab.com](mailto:leaves@gitlab.com) with your desired dates
1. Request the additional 5 weeks at least 4 weeks in advance

[Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > Denmark 🇩🇰]
**Maternity and Paternity Leave Payment**
The maximum maternity and paternity leave payment in Denmark is **DKK 4,865 per week (2025)** for full-time employees working 37 hours per week.

- If you are employed full-time and earn more than DKK 21,092 per month, you will receive the maximum weekly benefit of DKK 4,865 before tax.
- Maternity and paternity benefits are calculated based on your hourly wage (excluding Labour Market Contribution) and the number of hours of leave taken per week.
- In 2025, the maximum hourly rate for maternity benefits is DKK 131.49 per hour (4,865 ÷ 37 hours). If your hourly wage is lower than this, benefits will be paid at your usual hourly rate.
- Employees with a permanent job in addition to their education can apply for maternity benefits as a salaried employee for the hours during which they work.

If eligible, [GitLab's Parental leave](/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/leave-types/#gitlab-parental-leave) will be applied concurrently with the statutory leave and/or pay entitlements the team member is eligible for. GitLab will top up state maternity/paternity benefits to ensure you receive 100% of your salary for up to 16 weeks (*). Any additional leave taken (up to 52 weeks total) will be unpaid by GitLab and paid at the statutory rate only.

*GX (GitLab’s employer of record) will seek reimbursement from the public authority; Udbetaling Danmark for the state funded portion.

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family leaves > Paternity Leave]
Leave Entitlement

- Effective 6 April 2026, eligibility for Statutory Paternity Leave starts from a team member's first day of employment. The previous requirement of 26 weeks of continuous service is abolished.
- Team members can receive Statutory Paternity Pay for up to 2 weeks or up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- Eligible team members are entitled to £194.32 or 90% of the team member's average weekly earnings (whichever is lower) for up to 2 weeks OR up to 37 weeks if taking Shared Parental Leave
- GitLab's enhanced policy provides up to 16 weeks at 100% salary
- Leave must be taken within 52 weeks of the child's birth

How to Apply

- Submit leave request in Workday (Parental Leave Category) 30+ days before start
- Send completed [SPP Form](https://www.tax.service.gov.uk/print-and-post/form/PersonalTax_iForms/1.0/SC3/sc3.xdp) or one of the [SPL Forms](https://www.acas.org.uk/shared-parental-leave-form-templates) to leaves@gitlab.com
- The Absence Management team will notify payroll and email Vistra a copy of the form, dates of leave and outline what pay the team member is eligible for (statutory, supplemental, etc).
